author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Hard to belive IndieWebCamp Online is less than a week away! We have so many people joining us this is goind to be a great conference!

Eddie has been hard at work stress testing Jitsi and building out the conference sessions.

Start Brainstorming Proposals

Here is the session planning

How to propose a session

  • If you have an idea for a session or want help with something just add the idea at the top of the document
  • We provided a few example sentence starters -If you want to propose a session they will be between 21:00 UTC on March 8 and 20:00 UTC on March 9 -Just mark down the title, topic and times you can make, when more than one person can show up we can add it to the Session Grid (more on that later)
Daily Challenges

Below are a series of optional daily challenges to get everyone excited for IndieWebCamp Online

You do not need to complete these but we want to build a sense of community. The challenges:

  • 2019-03-04 Post an image that explains how you feel about attending IndieWebCamp Online.
  • 2019-03-05 Post your "Why" Why do you #IndieWeb
  • 2019-03-06 If you made a mix tape for IndieWebCamp Online what tracks would you add
  • 2019-03-07 What is one thing you want to learn? To teach? at IndieWebCamp Online
  • 2019-03-08 What sessions will you attend? Tell the world.

We look forward to seeing you in 7 days!!!!!
